and highlights

A final word regarding the vocabulary of restitution. 
Sometimes the 
term quasi-contract is used to describe a ground for recovering money in 
an action at common law, when the claim is not based on a true contract 
but instead seeks redress for unjust 
enrichment. 
Quantum 
meruit ("as 
much as is deserved") describes a type of action used for centuries in 
enforcing duties of payment for services. A related action for the worth of 
goods was quantum 
valebant ("as much as they were worth"). The term 
quantum meruit is often used interchangeably 
(if inexactly) with quasi-
contract. Restitution is a broader term used to embrace all of the grounds 
for recovery based on unjust enrichment.
